   153	def _evidence_summary(evidence: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
   154	    if evidence is None:
   155	        return {}
   156	    fields = (
   157	        "node_id",
   158	        "class_type",
   159	        "schema_less",
   160	        "confidence",
   161	        "raw_widget_count",
   162	        "candidate_widget_count",
   163	        "schema_widget_count",
   164	        "raw_widget_shape",
   165	        "has_dict_rows",
   166	        "overflow",
   167	        "provider",
   168	    )
   169	    return {field: _read_attr(evidence, field) for field in fields}

   172	class EditorAheadError(Exception):

   174
   175	    An editor-only uid is one that exists in the prior store but is absent from
   176	    the IR and was not authored by a prior VibeComfy emit (i.e. the node was

   187	        super().__init__(
   188	            f"editor_ahead: {len(editor_only_uids)} uid(s) in the prior store "
   189	            "were not authored by VibeComfy — use --force-drop to allow dropping them"
   190	        )
   191	        self.editor_only_uids = list(editor_only_uids)

   194	def _uid_to_litegraph_id(ui_json: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, str]:
   195	    """Build a ``{vibecomfy_uid: str(litegraph_id)}`` map from a UI JSON."""
   196	    out: dict[str, str] = {}
   197	    for node in ui_json.get("nodes", []) or []:
   198	        if not isinstance(node, dict):
   199	            continue
   200	        props = node.get("properties") or {}
   201	        uid = props.get("vibecomfy_uid")
   202	        if uid:
   203	            out[str(uid)] = str(node.get("id"))
   204	    return out

   207	def _api_node(api: Mapping[str, Any], node_id: str) -> Any:
   208	    """Look up an api-node by id, tolerating int/str key drift."""
   209	    if node_id in api:
   210	        return api[node_id]
   211	    if node_id.isdigit():
   212	        as_int = int(node_id)
   213	        if as_int in api:  # type: ignore[operator]
   214	            return api[as_int]  # type: ignore[index]
   215	    return None

   219	_INPUT_AXIS_FIELDS = frozenset(
   220	    {
     1	"""Emit a VibeWorkflow IR back to a litegraph (ComfyUI editor) JSON envelope.
     2
     3	This is the inverse direction of ingest: ``convert_to_vibe_format`` reads litegraph
     4	JSON into the ``VibeWorkflow`` IR; :func:`emit_ui_json` renders an IR back out to the
     5	litegraph shape that the ComfyUI web editor loads. It is a NEW standalone function and
     6	deliberately NOT a ``VibeWorkflow.compile`` backend — ``compile("api")`` must stay
     7	byte-for-byte identical and only ever produces the runtime API dict.
     8
     9	Identity preservation is **best-effort**, not lossless:
    10
    11	- ``properties["vibecomfy_uid"]`` is the stable identity key for nodes that carry a uid
    12	  (source-derived nodes ingested from litegraph JSON). Use this for round-trip lookup.
    13	- ``properties["vibecomfy_id"]`` is a display-only forward label (the emitter's
    14	  variable / role name, ``{class_type}_{order}``). It renumbers on edits and must NEVER
    15	  be used as a match key. Always present as a fallback when uid is absent.
    16	- ``properties["Node name for S&R"]`` is the litegraph node type, as the editor expects.
    17	- ``properties["ir_node_id"]`` is **no longer emitted** (demoted in M5). Any stale
    18	  ``ir_node_id`` value from a captured properties blob is scrubbed before emission.
    19
    20	Node ids in the litegraph envelope are integers (the editor format requires it): digit
    21	VibeNode ids keep their numeric value (``"98"`` → ``98``); non-digit ids are assigned
    22	fresh integers above the highest digit id. Parity is unaffected because the normalizer
    23	``str()``-coerces every node id on read-back. The top-level ``links[]`` are 6-element
    24	arrays ``[link_id, from_node, from_slot, to_node, to_slot, type]`` over those integer
    25	ids; ``definitions.subgraphs[].links[]`` (emitted only when the IR carries definitions)
    26	use the litegraph OBJECT shape. ``SetNode``/``GetNode`` broadcast helpers are resolved
    27	into direct links via :func:`collect_broadcast_sources` and omitted from ``nodes``.
    28
    29	No promise of lossless preservation is made. The envelope is byte-deterministic for a
    30	given IR: same IR in → same JSON out. All node geometry is stubbed and isolated in the
    31	single :func:`_stub_layout` helper, which M2 will replace with real layout; this module
    32	carries no layout-quality logic of its own.
    33
    34	``widgets_values`` emission rule (verified empirically against the Comfy oracle)
    35	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    36	ComfyUI's ``convert_ui_to_api`` reads ``widgets_values`` *positionally* against the
    37	raw object-info widget order, including ``None``-named UI-only slots such as
    38	KSampler's ``control_after_generate`` position. Therefore the emitted array is laid
    39	out against that raw order: named positions take the node's current value, ``None``
    40	positions preserve the captured source value when available, and seed control slots
    41	fall back to the documented ``"fixed"`` value. Trailing ``None`` is trimmed.

   180	def _canonicalize_coord(value: float) -> float:
   181	    """Round a coordinate value to M2 precision (2 decimal places).
   182
   183	    Every pos/size/group-bounding value emitted by this module passes through this
   184	    helper so two machines produce byte-identical JSON regardless of CWD, env,
   185	    or minor float-representation differences.

   190	def _canonicalize_group_geometry(groups: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
   191	    """Canonicalize ``bounding`` arrays in-place for every group in ``groups``.
   192
   193	    Each group's ``bounding`` is ``[x, y, width, height]`` — all four values are
   194	    rounded to M2 precision.  Groups without a valid ``bounding`` are left alone.
   195	    This guarantees byte-identical group geometry across machines when
   196	    ``include_main_positions=True``.
   197	    """
   198	    for g in groups:
   199	        bbox = g.get("bounding")
   200	        if isinstance(bbox, (list, tuple)) and len(bbox) == 4:
   201	            g["bounding"] = [
   202	                _canonicalize_coord(float(bbox[0])),
   203	                _canonicalize_coord(float(bbox[1])),
   204	                _canonicalize_coord(float(bbox[2])),
   205	                _canonicalize_coord(float(bbox[3])),
   206	            ]

   209	def _stub_layout(order: int) -> dict[str, list[float]]:
   210	    """Return deterministic placeholder geometry for the ``order``-th emitted node.
   211
   212	    ALL layout decisions live here. The grid is a pure function of emission order, so
   213	    the same IR always produces identical positions. M2 replaces this helper with real
   214	    layout; nothing elsewhere in the emitter reasons about geometry.
   215	    """
   216	    col = order % _STUB_COLUMNS
   217	    row = order // _STUB_COLUMNS
   218	    return {
   219	        "pos": [
   220	            _canonicalize_coord(float(col * _STUB_COLUMN_WIDTH)),
   221	            _canonicalize_coord(float(row * _STUB_ROW_HEIGHT)),
   222	        ],
   223	        "size": [_canonicalize_coord(s) for s in _STUB_NODE_SIZE],
   224	    }

   227	def _extract_geometry(layout_entry: dict | None) -> dict[str, list[float]] | None:
   228	    """Extract {pos, size} from a layout-store entry, or None.
   229
   230	    This isolates the pos/size geometry chain from the furniture resolver so the
   231	    two paths never accidentally couple.  A layout entry that is ``None`` or
   232	    lacks a valid ``pos`` returns ``None``, letting the caller fall through to
   233	    ``_captured_geometry`` or ``_stub_layout``.
   234	    """
   235	    if not isinstance(layout_entry, dict):
   236	        return None
   237	    pos = layout_entry.get("pos")
   238	    size = layout_entry.get("size")
   239	    if not isinstance(pos, (list, tuple)) or len(pos) < 2:
   240	        return None
   241	    if not isinstance(size, (list, tuple)) or len(size) < 2:
   242	        return None
   243	    return {
   244	        "pos": [_canonicalize_coord(float(pos[0])), _canonicalize_coord(float(pos[1]))],
   245	        "size": [_canonicalize_coord(float(size[0])), _canonicalize_coord(float(size[1]))],
   246	    }

   291	                # An edge entering a GetNode through its channel input is a
   292	                # display edge: the compiler resolves the GetNode's outbound
   293	                # through its channel and removes the helper-touching display
   294	                # edge (_compile/_resolve.py:136). Resolving the channel here
   295	                # means a resolvable chain never emits helper_input_unsupported;
   296	                # genuinely unresolvable channels (missing name, non-unique
   297	                # setter, non-unique setter inbound, cycles) still fail closed
   298	                # with the specific issue recorded by the walk.
   299	                _terminal, term_issues = terminal_source(consumer, source_output)
   300	                attribution[consumer_key].update(term_issues)
   301	                continue
   302	            record_issue(f"helper_input_unsupported:{consumer}")
   303	            attribution[consumer_key].add(f"helper_input_unsupported:{consumer}")
   304	            continue
   305	        terminal, term_issues = terminal_source(source, source_output)
   306	        attribution[consumer_key].update(term_issues)
   307	        if terminal is None:
   308	            continue
   309	        semantic.add(
   310	            (
   311	                terminal[0],
   312	                terminal[1],
   313	                aliases.get(consumer_uid, consumer_uid),
   314	                consumer_input,
   315	            )
   316	        )
   317
   318	    # Named-node attribution: an issue that names a graph-local node also
   319	    # belongs on that node's own uid, even when the failing walk was first
   320	    # observed from a different consumer (memoized resolution).
   321	    for issue in issues:
   322	        for mentioned_uid in _issue_mentioned_uids(issue, normalized_nodes):
   323	            attribution[mentioned_uid].add(issue)
   324
   325	    return (
   326	        tuple(sorted(semantic)),
   327	        tuple(sorted(issues)),
   328	        {uid: frozenset(issue_set) for uid, issue_set in attribution.items()},
   329	    )

   332	def _issue_mentioned_uids(
   333	    issue: str,
   334	    nodes: Mapping[str, SemanticNode],
   335	) -> frozenset[str]:
   336	    """Map the graph-local node ids named by a resolution issue to stable uids.
   337
   338	    ``unknown_source``/``unknown_consumer`` name ghost ids absent from
   339	    ``nodes`` by construction; they are attributed at record time instead of
   340	    here — ``unknown_source`` to the consuming edge's uid and
   341	    ``unknown_consumer`` to the known source's uid (B03 rework7).
   342	    """
   343	    code, _, rest = issue.partition(":")
   344	    parts = rest.split(":") if rest else []
   345	    if code == "duplicate_uid" and len(parts) >= 3:
   346	        # duplicate_uid:<uid>:<id_a>:<id_b>
   347	        mentioned = {parts[0]}
   348	        for node_id in parts[1:3]:
   349	            spec = nodes.get(node_id)
   350	            mentioned.add(spec[0] if spec else node_id)
   351	        return frozenset(mentioned)
   352	    if code == "cyclic_path":
   353	        node_ids = parts
   354	    elif code in {"unknown_source", "unknown_consumer"} or not parts:
   355	        return frozenset()
   356	    else:
   357	        node_ids = (parts[0],)
   358	    mentioned: set[str] = set()
   359	    for node_id in node_ids:
   360	        spec = nodes.get(node_id)
   361	        mentioned.add(spec[0] if spec else node_id)
   362	    return frozenset(mentioned)
   363

   365	def _snapshot_channel(snapshot_entry: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str | None:
   366	    for field_name, value_repr in snapshot_entry.get("widget_values_sig", ()):
   367	        if str(field_name) not in {"widget_0", "name"}:
   368	            continue
   369	        try:
   370	            value = ast.literal_eval(str(value_repr))
   371	        except (SyntaxError, ValueError):
   372	            value = value_repr
   373	        if value is not None:
   374	            return str(value)
   375	    return None
   376

   378	def _snapshot_semantic_graph(
   379	    snapshot: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]],
   380	) -> tuple[dict[str, SemanticNode], list[SemanticLink]]:
   381	    nodes = {
   382	        str(uid): (
   383	            str(uid),
   384	            str(entry.get("class_type", "")),
   385	            _snapshot_channel(entry),
   386	        )
   387	        for uid, entry in snapshot.items()
   388	    }
   389	    links: list[SemanticLink] = []
   390	    for source_uid, entry in snapshot.items():
   391	        for source_output, target in entry.get("outgoing_edge_sig", ()):
   392	            target_uid, target_input = target
   393	            links.append(
   394	                (str(source_uid), str(source_output), str(target_uid), str(target_input))
   395	            )
   396	        for target_input, source in entry.get("incoming_edge_sig", ()):
   397	            incoming_source_uid, source_output = source
   398	            links.append(
   399	                (
   400	                    str(incoming_source_uid),
   401	                    str(source_output),
   402	                    str(source_uid),
   403	                    str(target_input),
   404	                )
   405	            )
   406	    # A partial snapshot deliberately omits some node records while retained
   407	    # signatures may still name those peers. They remain valid opaque semantic
   408	    # endpoints; only the live graph must resolve every graph-local node id.
   409	    for source_uid, _source_output, target_uid, _target_input in links:
   410	        nodes.setdefault(source_uid, (source_uid, "", None))
   411	        nodes.setdefault(target_uid, (target_uid, "", None))
   412	    return nodes, links
   413
   414
   415	def _snapshot_consumer_uid_aliases(
   416	    nodes: Mapping[str, SemanticNode],
   417	    validated_live_aliases: Mapping[str, str],
   418	) -> dict[str, str]:
   419	    """Return only snapshot aliases corroborated by live lowering provenance.
   420
   421	    A clone-shaped UID is ordinary user data unless the live node carries a
   422	    validated ``vibecomfy.lowering`` record whose ``clone_uid`` round-trip
   423	    matches it.  Requiring that validated alias *and* the exact UID in the
   424	    snapshot gives both sides independent evidence and prevents textual UID
   425	    shape alone from fabricating snapshot topology.
   426	    """
   427	    snapshot_uids = {str(spec[0]) for spec in nodes.values()}
   428	    return {
   429	        str(uid): str(source_uid)
   430	        for uid, source_uid in validated_live_aliases.items()
   431	        if str(uid) in snapshot_uids
   432	    }
   433
   434
   435	def _workflow_semantic_graph(
   436	    current_ir: "VibeWorkflow",
   437	) -> tuple[dict[str, SemanticNode], list[SemanticLink], dict[str, str]]:
   438	    nodes: dict[str, SemanticNode] = {}
   439	    consumer_uid_aliases: dict[str, str] = {}
   440	    for node_id, node in current_ir.nodes.items():
   441	        channel = None
   442	        if node.class_type in {"SetNode", "GetNode"}:
   443	            value = node.inputs.get("widget_0", node.widgets.get("widget_0"))
   444	            if value is None:
   445	                value = node.inputs.get("name")
   446	            if value is not None:
   447	                channel = str(value)
   448	        stable_uid = str(node.uid if node.uid else node_id)
   449	        nodes[str(node_id)] = (
   450	            stable_uid,
   451	            str(node.class_type),
   452	            channel,
   453	        )
   454	        lowering = node.metadata.get("vibecomfy.lowering")
   455	        if isinstance(lowering, Mapping):
   456	            source_uid = lowering.get("source_uid")
   457	            loop_uid = lowering.get("loop_uid")
   458	            iteration_index = lowering.get("iteration_index")
   459	            if (
   460	                isinstance(source_uid, str)
   461	                and isinstance(loop_uid, str)
   462	                and isinstance(iteration_index, int)
   463	                and clone_uid(loop_uid, source_uid, iteration_index) == stable_uid
   464	            ):
   465	                consumer_uid_aliases[stable_uid] = source_uid
   466	    links = [
   467	        (str(edge.from_node), str(edge.from_output), str(edge.to_node), str(edge.to_input))
   468	        for edge in current_ir.edges
   469	    ]
   470	    return nodes, links, consumer_uid_aliases
   471

   473	def compute_field_delta(
   474	    snapshot: dict[str, Any],
   475	    current_ir: "VibeWorkflow",
   476	) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
   477	    """Compute field-level changes between a stored snapshot and the current IR.
   478
   479	    Parameters
   480	    ----------
   481	    snapshot:
   482	        A ``{uid: NodeFieldSnapshot}`` dict as returned by
   483	        ``capture_ingest_snapshot``.  This is the *before* state.
   484	    current_ir:
   485	        The live ``VibeWorkflow`` to compare against.  This is the *after* state.
   486
   487	    Returns
   488	    -------
   489	    ``{uid: {field_name: delta}}`` — only nodes and fields where something
   490	    changed. Scalar fields use ``(old_value, new_value)``; link changes use a
   491	    ``semantic_link_set`` record carrying canonical before/after sets and
   492	    resolution issues. Nodes absent from *snapshot* are omitted.
   493	    Nodes in *snapshot* but absent from *current_ir* (removed nodes) are also
   494	    omitted; callers that need to detect removals should diff snapshot keys against
   495	    the current IR's uid set directly.
   496	    """
   497	    # Build uid → node lookup for the current IR.
   498	    uid_to_node = {
   499	        (node.uid if node.uid else node_id): node
   500	        for node_id, node in current_ir.nodes.items()
   501	    }
   502
   503	    # Recompute current signatures inline to avoid a round-trip through capture.
   504	    nodes = current_ir.nodes
   505	    workflow_inputs = current_ir.inputs
   506
   507	    public_bindings: dict[str, list] = {node_id: [] for node_id in nodes}
   508	    for input_name, vibe_input in workflow_inputs.items():
   509	        if vibe_input.node_id in public_bindings:
   510	            public_bindings[vibe_input.node_id].append((input_name, vibe_input.field))
   511
   512	    after_nodes, after_links, after_aliases = _workflow_semantic_graph(current_ir)
   513	    before_nodes, before_links = _snapshot_semantic_graph(snapshot)
   514	    # Snapshot aliasing requires corroboration from both representations: the
   515	    # exact clone UID must exist in the snapshot and the corresponding live
   516	    # node must carry validated lowering metadata.  The after graph may also
   517	    # contain newly lowered clones absent from the snapshot, so it retains the
   518	    # complete validated live alias map.
   519	    before_aliases = _snapshot_consumer_uid_aliases(before_nodes, after_aliases)
   520	    canonical_before, before_issues, before_attribution = _canonical_semantic_link_set(
   521	        before_nodes,
   522	        before_links,
   523	        consumer_uid_aliases=before_aliases,
   524	    )
   525	    canonical_after, after_issues, after_attribution = _canonical_semantic_link_set(
   526	        after_nodes,
   527	        after_links,
   528	        consumer_uid_aliases=after_aliases,
   529	    )
   530	    # Issues with no per-uid attribution target (both endpoints ghost, e.g.
   531	    # ``unknown_source`` + ``unknown_consumer`` on a fully missing edge) cannot
   532	    # land on any single fence target.  They are surfaced on EVERY
   533	    # snapshot-present uid's ``semantic_link_set`` record so the pin fence
   534	    # fails closed with a typed ``RefusedEmit`` instead of letting the
   535	    # unresolved ghost edge crash the emitter with a bare ``KeyError``
   536	    # (B03 rework7).  Attributable issues never fan out (rework5 guarantee).
   537	    attributed_before = (
   538	        frozenset().union(*before_attribution.values())
   539	        if before_attribution
   540	        else frozenset()
   541	    )
   542	    attributed_after = (
   543	        frozenset().union(*after_attribution.values())
   544	        if after_attribution
   545	        else frozenset()
   546	    )
   547	    global_before_issues = tuple(sorted(set(before_issues) - attributed_before))
   548	    global_after_issues = tuple(sorted(set(after_issues) - attributed_after))
   549
   550	    delta: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
   551	    for uid, old_snap in snapshot.items():
   552	        node = uid_to_node.get(uid)
   553	        if node is None:
   554	            # Node removed after snapshot — omit per spec (caller diffs keys directly).
   555	            continue
   556
   557	        # Recompute the current signature for this node.
   558	        all_values = {**node.widgets, **node.inputs}
   559	        current: dict[str, Any] = {
   560	            "class_type": node.class_type,
   561	            "widget_values_sig": tuple(sorted((k, repr(v)) for k, v in all_values.items())),
   562	            "public_input_binding": tuple(sorted(public_bindings.get(node.id, []))),
   563	        }
   564
   565	        node_delta: dict[str, Any] = {}
   566	        for field_name in _SNAPSHOT_FIELDS:
   567	            old_val = old_snap[field_name]
   568	            new_val = current[field_name]
   569	            if old_val != new_val:
   570	                node_delta[field_name] = (old_val, new_val)
   571
   572	        uid_key = before_aliases.get(str(uid), str(uid))
   573	        before_incident = tuple(
   574	            link for link in canonical_before if link[0] == uid_key or link[2] == uid_key
   575	        )
   576	        after_incident = tuple(
   577	            link for link in canonical_after if link[0] == uid_key or link[2] == uid_key
   578	        )
   579	        # Resolution issues are attached only to the snapshot nodes actually
   580	        # involved (issue-named uids plus consumers of the failing edges), so
   581	        # a single ambiguous helper never fabricates a semantic-link delta on
   582	        # unrelated pins (B03 oracle finding 3 fan-out amplification).
   583	        before_uid_issues = tuple(sorted(before_attribution.get(uid_key, ())))
   584	        after_uid_issues = tuple(sorted(after_attribution.get(uid_key, ())))
   585	        if (
   586	            before_incident != after_incident
   587	            or before_uid_issues
   588	            or after_uid_issues
   589	            or global_before_issues
   590	            or global_after_issues
   591	        ):
   592	            node_delta["semantic_link_set"] = {
   593	                "before": before_incident,
   594	                "after": after_incident,
   595	                "before_resolution_issues": before_uid_issues,
   596	                "after_resolution_issues": after_uid_issues,
   597	                # Unattributed global issues (fully ghost endpoints) ride on
   598	                # every snapshot-present fence target (B03 rework7).
   599	                "global_before_resolution_issues": global_before_issues,
   600	                "global_after_resolution_issues": global_after_issues,
   601	            }
   602
   603	        if node_delta:
   604	            delta[uid] = node_delta
   605
   606	    return delta
   607

   340	    here — ``unknown_source`` to the consuming edge's uid and
   341	    ``unknown_consumer`` to the known source's uid (B03 rework7).

  1354	def test_pinned_semantic_orphaned_helpers_resolve_to_opaque_terminals(

  1364	    issues fabricated a ``link_delta`` on unchanged schema-less consumers

  1374	    assert issues == ()

    67	    clones to ``source/image -> consumer/images``.  The before set must be

    92	    snap = capture_ingest_snapshot({}, wf)

   396	def test_known_source_to_ghost_consumer_edge_carries_attributed_issue():
   397	    """A known source → missing-consumer edge must attribute ``unknown_consumer``
   398	    to the source's uid so the issue lands on a snapshot-present fence target.
   399
   400	    Before the fix the issue was recorded globally but never attributed, and
   401	    the global ``_after_issues`` result was discarded, so the semantic delta
   402	    came back ``{}`` and the pin fence saw nothing (B03 oracle finding 3).
   403	    """
   404	    wf = VibeWorkflow("wf", WorkflowSource("wf", None, "test"))
   405	    wf.nodes["1"] = VibeNode("1", "Producer", uid="source")

   409	    wf.edges = [VibeEdge("1", "0", "ghost", "input")]

   412	    assert "source" in delta
   413	    semantic = delta["source"]["semantic_link_set"]
   414	    assert semantic["before"] == ()
   415	    assert semantic["after"] == ()
   416	    assert semantic["before_resolution_issues"] == ()
   417	    assert semantic["after_resolution_issues"] == ("unknown_consumer:ghost",)
   418	    # The issue is attributed, so it must NOT fan out as a global issue.
   419	    assert semantic["global_before_resolution_issues"] == ()
   420	    assert semantic["global_after_resolution_issues"] == ()

   146	def collect_broadcast_sources(nodes: Mapping[str, Any], edges: Sequence[Any]) -> dict[str, list[Any]]:
   147	    sources: dict[str, list[Any]] = {}
   148	    edge_sources_by_target: dict[str, list[Any]] = {}
   149	    for edge in edges:

   154	            continue
   155	        from_output = _edge_attr(edge, "from_output")

   157	            output_slot = int(from_output)
   158	        except (TypeError, ValueError):
   159	            output_slot = 0
   160	        edge_sources_by_target[str(_edge_attr(edge, "to_node"))] = [str(_edge_attr(edge, "from_node")), output_slot]
   161
   162	    for node_id, node in nodes.items():
   163	        if _node_class_type(node) != "SetNode":
   164	            continue
   165	        name = broadcast_name(node)
   166	        if not name:
   167	            continue
   168	        direct_source = first_link_input(_compile_helper_inputs(node))
   169	        if direct_source is not None:
   170	            sources[name] = direct_source
   171	        elif str(node_id) in edge_sources_by_target:
   172	            sources[name] = edge_sources_by_target[str(node_id)]
   173	    return sources

   332	    wf.nodes["158"] = VibeNode("158", "Reroute", uid="158")
   333	    wf.nodes["601"] = VibeNode("601", "SetNode", uid="601", inputs={"name": "LATENT"})
   334	    wf.edges = [
   335	        VibeEdge("137", "0", "35", "frame_rate"),
   336	        VibeEdge("158", "0", "66", "round_to_multiple"),
   337	        VibeEdge("601", "0", "40", "samples"),
   338	    ]
